GO Battle League.title: Ultra League, Master League: Mega Edition, and 2026 GO LAIC Cup | Twilight Trails
GO Battle League.description:
The Ultra League, Master League: Mega Edition, and 2026 GO LAIC Cup will run from November 18, 2026, at 1:00 p.m. to November 25, 2026, at 1:00 p.m. PT.
Trainers will also receive 4× Stardust from win rewards (this does not include end-of-set rewards).
- Pokémon must be at or below 2,500 CP to enter.
- No CP limit.
- Mega-Evolved Pokémon are allowed.
- Pokémon must be at or below 1,500 CP to enter.
- Fire-, Dark-, Steel-, and Fairy-type Pokémon are not eligible.
- Legendary Pokémon, Mythical Pokémon, and Ultra Beasts are not eligible.
- Mega-Evolved Pokémon are not eligible for the GO Battle League version of this Cup. However, Mega-Evolved Pokémon will be eligible for the Pokémon Latin America International Championships 2026 in-person competition.
The following Pokémon will not be allowed.
- Chansey
- Snorlax
- Furret
- Wobbuffet
- Galarian Corsola
- Kingdra
- Medicham
- Altaria
- Dusclops
- Jellicent
- Jellicent
- Araquanid
- Oranguru
- Annihilape
- Clodsire

GO Battle League.description:
The Master League and Mega Catch Cup: Great League Edition will run from November 24, 2026, at 1:00 p.m. to December 1, 2026, at 1:00 p.m. PT.
Trainers will also receive 4× Stardust from win rewards (this does not include end-of-set rewards).
- All Pokémon are eligible.
- Pokémon must be at or below 1,500 CP to enter.
- Mega-Evolved Pokémon are allowed.
- Only Pokémon caught during the Twilight Trails Season are eligible.*
- Mythical Pokémon are not eligible.
*Pokémon must be caught between September 8, 2026, at 1:00 p.m. and December 1, 2026, at 1:00 p.m. PST.

Season.description:
Welcome to Pokémon GO: Twilight Trails!
In Pokémon GO, Seasons are periods of time that feature new events, Pokémon debuts, and surprises that all follow a certain theme. As the Seasons change, you may find different Pokémon appearing in your area and hatching from Eggs. Make sure to explore during each in-game Season to collect and train as many different Pokémon as you can! You’ll also enjoy special bonuses as you do.

Duo’s Pokémon Party, the limited-time Duolingo quest, starts on Tuesday, November 17, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. JST (Monday, November 16, at 5:00 p.m. PST).
